chunks: So go to him and say: 'The two of us have indeed been sent by your Lord. So let the children of Israel come with us, and do not oppress them. We have come to you with a token from your Lord. Peace on him who follows the way of guidance.'
ai.seo_question: What message did Musa and Harun deliver to Pharaoh regarding the Children of Israel?
ai.summary: In this verse, Musa and Harun convey their divine commission to Pharaoh, asserting their authority through the 'sign' (ayah) granted by Allah, which Shia exegesis often interprets as their miraculous proofs or the Quran itself. The closing salutation, 'Peace be upon he who follows guidance,' highlights the dual outcome of Pharaoh's rejection versus the reward for the obedient, a theme central to the narrative of Surah Taa-Haa.
